g.text: 3. Server generates JWT with payload and secret key

g.text: 4. Server send the JWT back to the client

g.text: 5. Client store the token in cookie, localstorage or sessionstorage

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 6. For every request client sends the JWT token along in the Authorization header

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 7. Server verifies the token using the secret key
